workouts.title: Happy Hips Pre-Test
workouts.description: Be sure to have your Happy Hips Scorecard printed to record your results and a phone or camera ready to take your before photos and even video your tests for your reference and review. Remember we'll be grading each test out of 3. Here’s a list of equipment you'll need to perform the tests below: Remember, not rush these test or push your body to extreme positions to get more range. It should feel like natural easy motion.

workouts.title: Happy Hips | Day 2
workouts.description: Welcome to Day 2 of Happy Hips! You'll find that two days each week will be self-directed sessions focused (i.e., no follow-along video) on developing strength/stability. The aim of these workouts will be to train those areas of the hips that tend to be weak, underdeveloped, or undertrained. The movements in the beginning may seem easy; however, they lay the foundation for our later progressions. It is imperative to master the basics before progressing to more difficult movements. Aim to complete all the reps and sets as prescribed.

workouts.description: Unlike our regular WODprep programs, Happy Hips spans 9 weeks instead of 8. This structure enables us to offer three distinct levels of progression difficulty, each lasting approximately 3 weeks. This is crucial as it provides more time to establish a solid foundation and dedicate sufficient time to advanced movements with heavier weights.

workouts.title: Happy Hips | Day 22
workouts.description: We are now exploring new areas. You have opened up the hips a bit, and they are getting stronger. Our next challenge is to start increasing your weights. If you have access to heavier weights for exercises that need them, try to add more weight each week. This is especially important for exercises like weighted hip thrusts and lunges. Increasing weight on these lifts will directly improve your main lifts like squats and deadlifts. The stronger you can become in these auxiliary lifts, the stronger you will become in your main lifts.

workouts.title: Happy Hips Post Test
workouts.description: Ensure you have your Week 1 Happy Hips Scorecard ready to document your results, and have a phone or camera prepared to record your test video for comparison with Week 1. Remember we'll be grading each test out of 3. Here’s a list of equipment you'll need to perform the tests below: Remember, not rush these test or push your body to extreme positions to get more range. It should feel like natural easy motion.

workouts.title: Post Test Analysis
workouts.description: Now that you’ve completed the Post course test, add up your score and compare to Week 1. Review your videos from each movement and compare.

items.movement: Share your before and after videos on the Wall of Wins to earn some free swag. WODprep Academy athletes can post questions and videos in the Academy Group Coaching space. Lastly, posting on social media? Don’t forget to tag us @WODprep.

Depending on your goals and milestones, you may wish to go through this programming again or come back to it if you find you need it. Fortunately, as a WODprep athlete you have access to this program and all future updates for life or as long as your a WODprep Academy member.
For those ready to continue the journey, we recommend Coach Garry's other mobility and strength courses ShoulderROM Unlocked and Functional Core.
